failure_types.description: The chosen live route is not available or adapter cannot run.
failure_types.answer_rule: State route unavailable and offer next safe route or manual review.

failure_types.description: No source was found for the current claim.
failure_types.answer_rule: State that no verified source was found and do not claim verified answer.

failure_types.description: Multiple sources conflict on a current-sensitive claim.
failure_types.answer_rule: State conflict, prefer official authority if available, and route to review.

failure_types.description: Available source or cache is too old for the claim.
failure_types.answer_rule: Mark as stale and require live refresh.

failure_types.description: Live route exists but policy gate blocks the request.
failure_types.answer_rule: Explain the safe boundary and redirect to approved workflow.

failure_types.description: Portal scout found CAPTCHA, OTP, login wall, outage, or manual blocker.
failure_types.answer_rule: Do not bypass. Capture blocker evidence and recommend Manual Application Package or review.
